exposure: Mode of delivery (cesarean section vs. vaginal delivery)
cohort: 16,084 singleton infants born between 34 and 41 weeks gestation
finding: Cesarean delivery not in labor increases the risk of newborn respiratory complications by about two-fold, independent of gestational age at delivery.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery not in labor adds a constant risk of newborn respiratory complications at any gestational age near-term and early-term.
